traceability.notes: Performance data extracted by claude-sonnet-5 reading the PDF directly (native document input), used as a fallback because the deterministic pdfplumber pipeline (summary_report_parser.py) found no per-category breakdown in this report. Model's own extraction notes: This is a qualitative (detection) method report. The primary/initial validation study (Table 5, page 15) reports 6 food categories with 3 sub-types (a/b/c) each; I recorded the category-level Total rows (which represent the actual ISO 16140-2 category, aggregating its sub-types) rather than the sub-type rows, per instructions to avoid granular sub-splits. The overall 'Total' row (all categories combined, 89.9/88.4/89.7/0.0) was excluded as a summary row. Note the report also contains a separate 2022/2025 extension study (Table 24, page 34) with 8 different categories (Multi-component foods, Meat products, Dairy products, Seafood and fishery products, Vegetables, Environmental samples, Dairy products 125g, Multi-component foods 125g) and different SE/RT values (e.g. Meat products 91.9/86.5/88.41); this extension is a separate/later study and was not used for the primary extraction, but is noted here for completeness. Certificate number was found only in title as '(certificate # UNI 03/04 – 04/05)' rather than as a standalone 'certificate number' field on a typical cover page.
